issue.title: test_logs_tab_g_and_shift_g_scroll_detail_extremes is a live reproducible flake blocking the flake-baseline gate
issue.description:
tests/ace/tui/test_logs_pane.py::test_logs_tab_g_and_shift_g_scroll_detail_extremes is flagged by tools/selection_health --fail-on-new-flake (reproducible_flake_nodeids), so just check-full is red at its final gate on master d4b913bb9 for every agent. Every earlier check-full step passes: all lint gates, SASE validation, committed-plans validation, and the full pytest cost lane.

EVIDENCE (queried directly from the durable record store at ~/.sase/test-selection/gh_sase-org__sase). Two qualifying full-run failure records exist after the current baseline cutoff (effective-after 2026-08-10T16:50:24Z), each the sole failure of its run, with disjoint change sets:
  1. head e01584098, changed files tests/_global_state_leak_detector.py + tests/conftest.py + tests/test_global_state_leak_detector.py (that is epic sase-j7.2's opt-in global-state leak detector, commit 6f4a032cd -- not the ACE logs pane).
  2. head ba77762e6, changed files under src/sase/ace/tui/{actions/agent_workflow/_prompt_bar_save_xprompt_snippets.py,modals/snippet_*,widgets/_prompt_input_bar_snippet_pane.py,widgets/prompt_stack.py} (epic sase-j3.5's snippet save confirmation).
The two change sets share no file, and neither touches src/sase/ace/tui/{actions,widgets} logs-pane code or tests/ace/tui/test_logs_pane.py, so the failure is not attributable to either change. Phase sase-j3.5 recorded the same node failing a full-suite escalation and then passing both an isolated rerun and a second just check, i.e. the fails-under-full-parallel / passes-in-isolation signature.

SCOPE: root-cause the node by mechanism (the scroll-extremes assertion in the logs tab appears timing- or settle-sensitive under the parallel lane) and fix it, or -- if it is judged baseline debt rather than a fixable mechanism -- add it to tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt naming this bead, per that file's header rule that additions require a filed bead. Root cause not yet investigated.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-ct — the live umbrella for the ACE TUI fails-under-full-parallel / passes-in-isolation flake class. This node has that exact signature, but is filed node-specific (not corroborated onto sase-ct) because it crosses the reproducible-flake gate and blocks just check-full, matching the routing that sase-j4 and sase-j6 already use for gate-blocking nodes.

RELATED: sase-j6 — the other node the same flake-baseline gate run named on master d4b913bb9 (tests/test_bead/test_plus_one_presentation.py::test_post_close_plus_one_badge_marker_search_and_json_agree). Both must clear before just check-full is green; a shared parallel-lane mechanism would explain both, so triage them together.
RELATED: sase-j5 — flake-baseline gate never clears a renamed or deleted test's node ID; same gate, different defect (baseline bookkeeping rather than this node's mechanism).

CONTEXT from epic sase-j8's land agent: landing sase-j8 required bumping the flake-baseline 'effective-after' cutoff in tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt from 2026-08-10T16:50:24Z to 2026-08-10T23:36:35Z (one second past commit 9c46891c5), because the gate was judging this epic's own pre-fix history for tests/test_keymaps_registry_loading.py::test_stitches_action_override_wins_over_legacy_commits_alias. Same mechanism and precedent as commit 83bb8a6f7. Side effect for this bead: every full-run record that previously supplied evidence for test_logs_tab_g_and_shift_g_scroll_detail_extremes predates the new cutoff (latest was 2026-08-10T21:33:43Z at HEAD ba77762e6), so the gate no longer reports it. The flake itself was not fixed — no node IDs were added to or removed from the baseline list. If it is still live, future full-lane runs will re-collect evidence and re-flag it.

evidence.note: Observed since: 2026-08-11T00:00:00Z. Independent reproduction during fix_global_state_leaks verification: just check-full passed lint, SASE validation, committed-plans validation, and just test-cost, then failed only at selection-health --fail-on-new-flake naming tests/ace/tui/test_logs_pane.py::test_logs_tab_g_and_shift_g_scroll_detail_extremes and tests/test_bead/test_plus_one_presentation.py::test_post_close_plus_one_badge_marker_search_and_json_agree. This work touched the global-state leak detector/test wiring and a stale Symvision cleanup, not the ACE logs pane.

Follow-up proposed by phase sase-j9.1 and independently verified during sase-j9 landing on 2026-08-10/11: just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake still names tests/ace/tui/test_logs_pane.py::test_logs_tab_g_and_shift_g_scroll_detail_extremes as a reproducible flake that blocks the check-full meta-gate at HEAD c0238421b, while a direct isolated pytest run passes (1 passed).

Independent reproduction during external_ref_bead_identity verification: just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake failed after all Rust checks, just check, and test-cost passed, naming tests/ace/tui/test_logs_pane.py::test_logs_tab_g_and_shift_g_scroll_detail_extremes as a reproducible flake. This work touched bead external_ref storage/wire/CLI/linking and a stale keymap test, not the ACE logs pane.

Independent reproduction during sase-jd.8 landing (retire Bugs pane / rename PRs to Patches): just test-scoped failed once with assert scroll.scroll_y == scroll.max_scroll_y (0.0 != 190) after pressing G to jump to bottom of a scrollable detail pane, then passed 3/3 in immediate isolated reruns. File tests/ace/tui/test_logs_pane.py was not touched by this work (confirmed via git diff --stat). Matches the fails-under-parallel / passes-in-isolation signature already on record.

Independent recurrence on 2026-08-12 while repairing default-branch CI at pinned master 62951abcb4a20d3c7ad5c01190433ee91f837f9c: just check-full failed only tests/ace/tui/test_logs_pane.py::test_logs_tab_g_and_shift_g_scroll_detail_extremes after 29,002 tests passed. The patch changes docs PDF tooling, release workflow ordering, two clipboard-test waits, and test-cost budgets—not Logs-pane implementation or its test. The exact node then passed 31 consecutive isolated runs.

payload.entry: Backlog triage (owner-requested seven-bead cut, 2026-08-12): the node is listed under a '# sase-jb' comment in tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt at HEAD 62951abcb, so 'just check-full' is no longer red on it and no agent is blocked. The underlying mechanism (fails under the full parallel lane on a contended host, passes in isolation) is shared with sase-j6 and sase-jq; sase-jq stays open as the owner of that class because its five test_core_vcs_log.py nodes are NOT baselined and still block the gate. The baseline entry stands as debt. Reopen with a +1 if this node needs de-baselining or starts failing outside the lane.

payload.close_reason: Baselined debt; the flake class is tracked by sase-jq

evidence.note: Independent recurrence during mirrored_bead_status_sync verification on 2026-08-12: just check escalated to the full non-visual suite and failed tests/ace/tui/test_logs_pane.py::test_logs_tab_g_and_shift_g_scroll_detail_extremes alongside one unrelated snippet-modal node. The current diff touches external issue mirroring, CLI/help/docs, and mirror tests, not the ACE logs pane. The exact node passed immediately in isolation with .venv/bin/pytest tests/ace/tui/test_logs_pane.py::test_logs_tab_g_and_shift_g_scroll_detail_extremes -vv.
